If you choose to learn the mnemonic Major System, you can easily convert your Numzi-words in your head, or if you prefer, you can simply use the Numzi App to retrieve your number.

The Numzi Peg Word list includes a Peg Word Story to help you remember the peg words.  Combining the Major System with the corresponding phonetic Peg Word list system helps improve your memory using the same methods as the world memory champions.
